summary.text: Roger Kirby is a Democratic member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from District 101 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
A realtor and appraiser, he assumed office on November 14, 2022.

paragraphs.text: Roger Kirby was born in Florence County, South Carolina, and lives in Lake City, South Carolina.
He earned a degree from Furman University in 1982.

His career experience includes working as a realtor and appraiser, and he has served as president of the Pee Dee Realtor Association, on the South Carolina Realtor Association Executive Committee, on the Florence County Transportation Commission, and on the Florence County Planning and Zoning Commission.
Kirby assumed office in the South Carolina House of Representatives on November 14, 2022, and his current term ends on November 9, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists him on the Labor, Commerce and Industry Committee for 2025-2026.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026, and faces Republican Arnie Borowsky in the general election.
